name: predatory-vogue-cover
image_purpose: fashion cover and campaign key visual

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic dark high-fashion editorial portrait with controlled dramatic tension and sculptural styling.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, long straight hair with blunt bangs, realistic natural skin texture, and a deliberate confident gaze. She wears tailored fitted pants and feather-textured arm pieces with individually visible fibers, clearly separated from skin.
prompt.composition_elements: Low forward-leaning crawling fashion pose set diagonally across the frame, one hand grounded under weight and the other lifted near the face in a claw-like editorial gesture, minimalist dark gradient studio background, sharp focus on eyes and hands.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft upper-front key light shapes facial planes, strong rear rim light carves the silhouette, deep controlled shadows and high contrast, dark glamorous studio atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50-85mm fashion-editorial lens look, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical composition, natural anatomy, photorealistic 8K-style detail, realistic hair, fabric, feather, and skin texture.
